A '''frozen moon''' lay in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a [[blue]] [[Unidentified gas giant (UR-2212-GR system)|gas giant]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and was the largest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of its [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The moon had extensive wildlife all over its frozen [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].

==History==
The moon was the location for a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial research facility|research facility]] for a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] experiment ordered by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], to produce [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] clones using [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] DNA. The experiment went badly when the clones [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the facility.<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>

The Empire did not return and the surviving clones remained on the moon until [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]] when [[Jaden Korr]] was [[Mission to the frozen moon|led there]] by a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]], followed by [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kell Douro]], who was hunting Korr for his [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]. Korr [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] and killed [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]], a clone of [[Kam Solusar]], and [[Khedryn Faal]] killed Douro, and the remaining clones and their children escaped in the assassin's ship.

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
According to Jaden Korr's visions that first led him to the frozen moon, the escaped clones may have been cloned from [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], [[Lassin]], or [[Lumiya]]. These figures appeared in the vision along with [[Kam Solusar]], the source for the clone [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was also mentioned by one of the Doctors' holorecordings. They may also have been cloned from other Force users known to the Galactic Empire prior to [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn's death]].
